name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]

permissions: {}

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  version-pr:
    # After a release merge, decide reads the new tags: before execute pushes them it would re-infer released commits.
    needs: [plan, execute]
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.plan.result == 'success' &&
      (needs.plan.outputs.release != 'true' || needs.execute.result == 'success')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: {contents: write, pull-requests: write}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with: {fetch-depth: 0, persist-credentials: false}
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/callisto-action@9234c02c00f65c7b742da4f4dd8b9fdbfbb0215a # callisto@0.22.0
        with: {mode: version-pr, branch: "main"}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

  plan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: {contents: read}
    outputs:
      release: ${{ steps.decision.outputs.release }}
      matrix: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.matrix }}
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: npm-dist
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-assets
      - name: Write the artifact manifest
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true' || needs.plan.outputs.has_python == 'true' || needs.plan.outputs.has_npm == 'true'
        env:
          HAS_PYTHON: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.has_python }}
          HAS_NPM: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.has_npm }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--intent "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json" --artifact-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-assets"
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-manifest.json")
          if [[ "$HAS_PYTHON" == true ]]; then args+=(--seal-python); fi
          if [[ "$HAS_NPM" == true ]]; then args+=(--seal-npm); fi
          callisto release artifact-manifest "${args[@]}"
      - name: Execute the release
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--intent "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json" --receipt "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt.json"
            --orchestration-revision "$GITHUB_SHA")
          if [[ -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-manifest.json" ]]; then
            args+=(--artifact-manifest "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-manifest.json" --artifact-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-assets")
          fi
          if [[ -n "${NPM_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
            npmrc="$RUNNER_TEMP/publish-npmrc"
            user_npmrc="${NPM_CONFIG_USERCONFIG:-${HOME:-}/.npmrc}"
            if [[ -f "$user_npmrc" ]]; then cp "$user_npmrc" "$npmrc"; else : > "$npmrc"; fi
            chmod 600 "$npmrc"
            printf '\n%s\n' "//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=\${NPM_TOKEN}" >> "$npmrc"
            export CALLISTO_PUBLISH_NPM_CONFIG="$npmrc"
          fi
          callisto release execute "${args[@]}"
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
          NPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE: "true"
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Print the cargo-semver-checks release type for the michi fixed group's pending changesets.

Only the YAML front matter of `.changeset/*.md` counts, and only entries naming a fixed-group package (the group
releases together, so any member's bump is everyone's). cargo-semver-checks
names release types literally, so before 1.0 Callisto's minor bump (0.4 -> 0.5) is `major` here.

Prints `infer` when no changeset names a fixed-group package: then the version in the manifests is the guide (on
Callisto's version PR the changesets are already applied and the versions bumped).

Usage: scripts/pending-release-type.py <current michi-core version> [changeset dir]
"""

import pathlib
import re
import sys

GROUP = {"michi-core", "michi-graph", "michi-pipeline", "michi-node", "@orin-dx/michi"}
RANK = {"none": 0, "patch": 1, "minor": 2, "major": 3}


def front_matter_bumps(text: str):
    """(package, level) pairs from a changeset's front matter, or nothing if it has none."""
    match = re.match(r"\A---[ \t]*\r?\n(.*?)\r?\n---[ \t]*(\r?\n|\Z)", text, re.S)
    if not match:
        return []
    bumps = []
    for line in match.group(1).splitlines():
        entry = re.match(r"""^\s*["']?([^"':]+?)["']?\s*:\s*["']?(major|minor|patch|none)["']?\s*$""", line)
        if entry:
            bumps.append((entry.group(1), entry.group(2)))
    return bumps


def main() -> int:
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print(__doc__, file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    version = sys.argv[1]
    directory = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else ".changeset")

# Everything not set here is Callisto's default: changesets in `.changeset`, the default cascade, every package

[[package]]
match = "cargo/michi-core"
# One GitHub release per version for the whole group, attached here and tagged michi@{version}. Callisto keeps a tag
# per package (it finds each package's last release from its own tag and rejects a shared tag, E194), so the other
# members keep {name}@{version}; this mirrors Callisto's own callisto@{version} release tag.

tag-template = "michi@{version}"
previous-tag-templates = ["michi-core@{version}"]

[[fixed-group]]
name = "michi"
members = ["cargo/michi-core", "cargo/michi-graph", "cargo/michi-pipeline", "npm/@orin-dx/michi"]

name: 'Setup Callisto Environment'
description: 'Sets up Rust toolchain, Cargo cache, moon and the .prototools toolchain, and Callisto CLI'
inputs:
  source:
    description: 'Where to obtain Callisto: auto installs the requested release version; local builds validated Callisto checkout source and ignores version. Release jobs must use local.'
    required: false
    default: 'auto'
  version:
    description: >-
      Version tag of Callisto to install. Default 'latest' installs the release this action's
      own invocation is pinned to (github.action_ref resolved against callisto@ tags), falling
      back to the newest published release when that ref is unset or unresolvable.
    required: false
    default: 'latest'
  verification:
    description: >-
      Attestation verification of the prebuilt release asset (gh attestation verify, repo
      orin-dx/callisto, signer workflow callisto-release.yml, source ref refs/heads/main). One of: require = a failed
      verification or missing gh aborts the step and the asset is never run; fallback (default) =
      on failure or missing gh, warn, delete the asset and install from crates.io instead (never
      run the unverified asset); skip = do not verify, warn, and use the asset. Releases built
      before the first attested release carry no attestation, hence the fallback default.
    required: false
    default: 'fallback'

runs:
  using: 'composite'
  steps:
    - name: Install Rust Toolchain & Cache
      # orin-dx/actions/setup-rust v1.1
  setup_callisto:
    description: 'Internal: may change without notice. Install the Callisto environment before running'
    required: false
    default: 'true'
  version:
    description: >-
      Version tag of Callisto to install. Default 'latest' installs the release this action's own
      invocation is pinned to (github.action_ref resolved against callisto@ tags), falling back to
      the newest published release when that ref is unset or unresolvable.
    required: false
    default: 'latest'
  cwd:
    description: 'Workspace directory'
    required: false
    default: '.'
  mode:
    description: 'version-pr (default): create/update the release PR. release: run `callisto release`. execute: run `callisto release execute` on the `handoff` directory.'
    required: false
    default: 'version-pr'
  handoff:
    description: 'mode: execute only. Directory holding release-intent.json, the files a credential-free job packaged, and release-manifest.json when it sealed any.'
    required: false
    default: ''
outputs:
  hasChangesets:
    description: 'Whether pending changesets were found (mode: version-pr only)'
    value: ${{ steps.version-pr.outputs.hasChangesets }}
  published:
    description: 'Whether `callisto release` or `callisto release execute` published anything (mode: release or execute only; otherwise false)'
    value: ${{ steps.release.outputs.published || 'false' }}
  publishedPackages:
    description: 'JSON array of packages `callisto release` or `callisto release execute` published (mode: release or execute only; otherwise [])'
    value: ${{ steps.release.outputs.publishedPackages || '[]' }}
runs:
  using: composite
name: 'Callisto Validate Action'
description: 'Validates pending changesets, package discovery, configuration health, and release plan DAG'

runs:
  using: 'composite'
  steps:
    - name: Setup Callisto Environment
      uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto

    - name: Validate Configuration, Package Discovery & Changesets
      shell: bash
      env:
        FORCE_COLOR: "1"
        CLICOLOR_FORCE: "1"
      # `callisto status --check` exits 0 with no error diagnostics, else 1; `shell: bash` fails the step on it.
      run: callisto status --check

    - name: Pre-Flight Release Plan Simulation (DAG Pre-Check)
      shell: bash
      env:
        FORCE_COLOR: "1"
        CLICOLOR_FORCE: "1"
      run: |
        echo "::group::Simulating Release Plan"
        callisto release --dry-run --format text
        echo "::endgroup::"

    - name: Render PR Release Pre-Flight Summary
      shell: bash
      env:
        FORCE_COLOR: "1"
        CLICOLOR_FORCE: "1"
      run: |
        echo "### Callisto Release Pre-Flight Verification" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo "- **Package Discovery**: All workspace crates and packages are correctly tracked." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo "- **Configuration Health**: \`callisto.toml\` schema and rules are valid." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo "- **Changeset Integrity**: Pending changesets are valid." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo "#### Workspace Package Status" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

  # Callisto's own pre-flight: config health, package discovery, changeset syntax, and a dry run of the release plan.
  callisto:
    name: Callisto pre-flight
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/callisto-validate@aebeedcdaa1dce8f0d9ad1836844ab6be68daf1f # callisto@0.20.0

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          components: rustfmt,clippy
      - run: cargo fmt --all --check
      - run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings
      - name: typos
        uses: crate-ci/typos@276087d9a4f06398b3e04825487805e2d7375888 # v1.52.2

# Callisto publishing migration

Status: Callisto 0.10 adopted; release sequence set by ADR 4. The release workflow has since moved to Callisto 0.12 (`.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml`); the evidence below is from the 0.10 migration.

## Evidence

The Callisto 0.10 CLI recognizes all three `napi.targets`. Package rules require ecosystem-qualified IDs; the previous path-like selectors matched no packages. The corrected selectors produce no status warnings.

The new workflow pins Callisto's setup and release actions to `callisto@0.10.0`. It creates version PRs with `mode: version-pr`, accepts a release only from a verified merge of the managed PR, and checks every NAPI artifact before publishing. NAPI no longer creates a separate GitHub release; Callisto owns tags and releases.

A dry run on this workspace plans all current Cargo and npm package versions because Callisto has no release history for these packages. Review that package set and the selected versions before the first release. External consumer integration follows publication; see [ADR 4](../adr/0004-publish-before-consumer-integration.md).

## Verification limit

`actionlint` and `git diff --check` pass. Callisto's 0.10 matrix and status commands pass. The local pnpm shim could not update its permissions, so the NAPI CLI help check could not run. No publication was attempted.

# (docs/releasing.md in orin-dx/callisto): a push to main either refreshes the

name: Release

# Callisto's build-matrix release flow for napi platform packages
# (docs/releasing.md in orin-dx/callisto): a push to main either refreshes the
# Callisto version PR or, for a merged version PR, runs plan -> build ->
# execute. Keep this filename: Callisto's recovery docs and coordinator
# identity name `.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml`.

input.content:
version-pr:
    name: Create or update the Callisto version PR
    needs: release-candidate
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release != 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: callisto-version-pr
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      # The default version command (`callisto version`) refreshes lockfiles
      # and the action appends --emit-decision .callisto/release-decision.json.
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/callisto-action@9234c02c00f65c7b742da4f4dd8b9fdbfbb0215a # callisto@0.22.0
        with:
          mode: version-pr
          version: callisto@0.22.0
          branch: main
          release_branch: callisto/version-packages
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

  plan:
    name: Plan the release from the merged version PR
    needs: release-candidate
    if: needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.matrix }}
      napi_dir: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.napi_dir }}
      has_napi: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.has_napi }}
      has_npm: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.has_npm }}
      has_cargo: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.has_cargo }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@9234c02c00f65c7b742da4f4dd8b9fdbfbb0215a # callisto@0.22.0
        with:
          version: callisto@0.22.0
          # Run only a Callisto binary whose attestation verifies; the default falls back to a crates.io build.
          verification: require

      - name: Plan the release
        env:
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          ORCHESTRATION_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent"
          callisto release plan --from-release-commit "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA" --decision .callisto/release-decision.json \
            --orchestration-revision "$ORCHESTRATION_SHA" --artifact-repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json"
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent" && shasum -a 256 release-intent.json > release-intent.json.sha256)

      - name: Build the matrix from the intent's napi targets
        id: matrix
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          intent="$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json"
          # This workflow builds napi addons, packages crates and packs npm packages. Artifact slots (binary release
          # assets) and PyPI publishes need the generated workflow's asset build and build-python jobs.
          if ! jq -e '(.artifactSlots // []) == [] and
            ([.operations[].id.package | select(startswith("pypi/"))] == [])' "$intent" > /dev/null; then
            echo "::error::the release intent declares artifact slots or PyPI publishes, which this workflow does not build"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Only packages in the release intent: an unrelated addon adds no build.
          {
            while IFS= read -r package; do
              callisto --format json matrix --package "$package"
            done < <(jq -r '[.operations[].id.package] | unique[]' "$intent")
          } | jq -s '{platformTargets: (map(.platformTargets) | add // {})}' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/matrix.json"
          # Callisto's hostRunner/useCross as given (aarch64 and musl Linux cross-compile with cargo-zigbuild on
          # ubuntu-latest; both macOS targets build on macos-latest).
          matrix=$(jq -c '[.platformTargets[] | select(.kind == "napi") | .targets[]] | unique_by(.artifactName)' \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/matrix.json")
          # pack-npm places one package's JS binding; a second addon needs per-package placement. A release with no
          # addon skips the build and placement entirely (the fixed group always includes the npm package today).
          napi_dirs=$(jq -c '[.[].packageDir] | unique' <<< "$matrix")
          case $(jq length <<< "$napi_dirs") in
            0) has_napi=false napi_dir="" ;;
            1) has_napi=true napi_dir=$(jq -r '.[0]' <<< "$napi_dirs") ;;
            *)
              echo "::error::expected at most one napi package directory, got $napi_dirs"
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac
          {
            echo "matrix=$matrix"
            echo "napi_dir=$napi_dir"
            echo "has_napi=$has_napi"
            echo "has_cargo=$(jq '[.operations[].id | select(.role.kind == "registryPublish" and
              (.package | startswith("cargo/")))] | length > 0' "$intent")"
            echo "has_npm=$(jq '[.operations[].id | select(.role.kind == "platformPublish" or
              (.role.kind == "registryPublish" and (.package | startswith("npm/"))))] | length > 0' "$intent")"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  # Runs project code (build scripts, the napi CLI) with no registry credential and no OIDC token: the attest job signs
  # what it uploads.
  build:
    name: Build ${{ matrix.triple }}
    needs: [release-candidate, plan]
    # An empty matrix is an error in GitHub Actions, so a release without an addon skips the job instead.
    if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include: ${{ fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.matrix) }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.hostRunner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      TRIPLE: ${{ matrix.triple }}
      USE_CROSS: ${{ matrix.useCross }}
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ${{ matrix.packageDir }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install the Rust target
        run: rustup target add "$TRIPLE"

      !cancelled() && needs.plan.result == 'success' &&
      (needs.build.result == 'success' || (needs.build.result == 'skipped' && needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'false')) &&
      (needs.attest.result == 'success' || (needs.attest.result == 'skipped' && needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'false')) &&

      # and refuses an npm publish the manifest does not seal (E306).
      - name: Write the artifact manifest

        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          callisto release artifact-manifest --intent "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json" \

      # CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN and NPM_TOKEN are long-lived secrets because Callisto has no OIDC trusted publishing yet,
      # so they cannot be dropped here. Revisit when it does (the job already holds id-token: write).
      - name: Execute the release

          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
          # Every npm package, @orin-dx/michi included, is now an `npm publish <tarball>`, which honours this.
          NPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE: 'true'
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ORCHESTRATION_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Callisto hands this config only to its npm publishers; the token
          # stays an ${NPM_TOKEN} reference, never written to disk.
          # shellcheck disable=SC2016
          printf '//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=${NPM_TOKEN}\n' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/callisto-npmrc"
          chmod 600 "$RUNNER_TEMP/callisto-npmrc"
          export CALLISTO_PUBLISH_NPM_CONFIG="$RUNNER_TEMP/callisto-npmrc"
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt"
          args=(--intent "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json"
            --receipt "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt/release-receipt.json" --orchestration-revision "$ORCHESTRATION_SHA")
          if [[ -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-manifest.json" ]]; then
            args+=(--artifact-manifest "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-manifest.json" --artifact-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-assets")
          fi
          callisto release execute "${args[@]}"

      # Callisto writes the receipt only after every selected operation succeeded. A registry publish that landed in
      # this run (`published`) or that a re-run adopted from a failed earlier attempt (`alreadySatisfied`) names the
      # released version here. A receipt without registry publishes, or no receipt, leaves the output empty and
      # skips the post-release smoke test.
      - name: Find the version this run released
        id: published
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version=$(scripts/released-version.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt/release-receipt.json")
          echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Summarize the receipt
        if: always()
        run: |
          receipt="$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt/release-receipt.json"
          if [[ -f "$receipt" ]]; then
            {
              echo '### Release receipt'
              echo '```json'
              cat "$receipt"
              echo '```'
            } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        if: always()
        with:
          # Per attempt: a re-run keeps each attempt's receipt instead of shadowing it.
          name: release-receipt-attempt-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-receipt
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 30

  # Installs the versions just published from the public registries into clean projects on each platform we ship
  # prebuilt binaries for, and uses them (scripts/smoke-published.sh). Needs no secrets and no write access. It
  # cannot undo a release: a failure here is the alarm that the published packages are broken.
  smoke-published:
    name: Smoke-test the published release (${{ matrix.os }})
    needs: [release-candidate, execute]
    if: needs.execute.result == 'success' && needs.execute.outputs.smoke_version != ''
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04-arm, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      RELEASED_VERSION: ${{ needs.execute.outputs.smoke_version }}
      # Every npm package of this release must carry provenance; a missing one fails the job.
      SMOKE_REQUIRE_ATTESTATIONS: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install the published packages and use them
        run: scripts/smoke-published.sh "$RELEASED_VERSION"

        with:

          version: callisto@0.22.0

    name: Plan the release from the merged version PR
    needs: release-candidate

      napi_dir: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.napi_dir }}
      has_napi: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.has_napi }}
      has_npm: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.has_npm }}
      has_cargo: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.has_cargo }}

          verification: require

          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent"
          callisto release plan --from-release-commit "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA" --decision .callisto/release-decision.json \

            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json"

          if ! jq -e '(.artifactSlots // []) == [] and

            exit 1

              (.role.kind == "registryPublish" and (.package | startswith("npm/"))))] | length > 0' "$intent")"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  # Runs project code (build scripts, the napi CLI) with no registry credential and no OIDC token: the attest job signs
  # what it uploads.
  build:
    name: Build ${{ matrix.triple }}
    needs: [release-candidate, plan]
    # An empty matrix is an error in GitHub Actions, so a release without an addon skips the job instead.
    if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include: ${{ fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.matrix) }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.hostRunner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      TRIPLE: ${{ matrix.triple }}
      USE_CROSS: ${{ matrix.useCross }}
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ${{ matrix.packageDir }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install the Rust target
        run: rustup target add "$TRIPLE"

      # Known gap: this composite runs moonrepo/setup-toolchain@v0 (floating tag, pinned only by the composite's own
      # SHA), which downloads and runs the proto and moon install scripts from moonrepo/moon's master branch
      # ("Installing `moon` globally", because .moon/ exists). Neither can be pinned from here: the script URL is
      # hardcoded in that action, and the only inputs (proto-version, moon-version) pick the release the script
      # fetches, not the script itself. Replacing the composite with a pinned setup-toolchain would still run the
      # proto script, and auto-install would add rust to the proto installs. These jobs never call moon.
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-proto-node-pnpm@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          working-directory: ${{ matrix.packageDir }}
          cache: 'false'

      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # napi's --cross-compile links non-native Linux targets with cargo-zigbuild. The linker is pinned by version and
      # wheel hash (x86_64 and aarch64 Linux runners). Bump both together from the ziglang release page on PyPI.
      - name: Install zig
        if: matrix.useCross
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          pip install --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: -r /dev/stdin <<'REQS'
          ziglang==0.17.1 \
            --hash=sha256:ea6cc5d87b033cf0aedfbc8f9549a908cae6c50ac31f1698188fa48a74524b54 \
            --hash=sha256:b7c5f02fccd40f89b999ee16a1f5ddced56e6182370f8affe494bcf8a28cf07e
          REQS

      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@cfdb7ed4ccc7c7dce37759eae89dc5674b469b39 # v2
        if: matrix.useCross
        with:
          tool: cargo-zigbuild

      # --output-dir keeps the checkout clean; napi writes the .node file and
      # the generated index.js/index.d.ts there.
      - name: Build the napi addon
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--release --target "$TRIPLE" --output-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/napi-out")
          if [[ "$USE_CROSS" == true ]]; then args+=(--cross-compile); fi
          pnpm build "${args[@]}"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: napi-${{ matrix.artifactName }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-out/*.node
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

      # index.js and index.d.ts are gitignored build outputs the npm package ships.
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: binding-${{ matrix.artifactName }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-out/index.js
            ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-out/index.d.ts
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  # Signs the bytes that get packed (each addon and the JS loader that requires it); pack-npm verifies them before it
  # places them. Holds the OIDC token, so it has no checkout and runs no command: only the attestation action sees the
  # build output. Every leg builds the same loader, so the merged download keeps one copy; pack-npm verifies each
  # leg's copy against this attestation, which also fails on a leg whose loader differs.
  attest:
    name: Attest the napi addons and JS binding
    needs: [plan, build]
    if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          pattern: napi-*
          merge-multiple: true
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-artifacts

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          pattern: binding-*
          merge-multiple: true
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-binding

      - uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-artifacts/*.node
            ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-binding/index.js
            ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-binding/index.d.ts

  # No registry credentials: compiles every crate of the release (build scripts, proc macros), so that execute
  # publishes them with --no-verify.
  package-cargo:
    name: Package the crates
    needs: [release-candidate, plan]
    if: needs.plan.outputs.has_cargo == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@9234c02c00f65c7b742da4f4dd8b9fdbfbb0215a # callisto@0.22.0
        with:
          version: callisto@0.22.0
          verification: require

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent

      - name: Verify the handoff
        run: (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent" && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)

      - name: Package the crates
        run: callisto release package-cargo --intent "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json"

  # No registry credentials: verifies and places the napi build, then packs every npm package (the six platform
  # packages and @orin-dx/michi). execute publishes these exact tarballs with `npm publish <tarball> --ignore-scripts`.
  pack-npm:
    name: Pack the npm packages
    needs: [release-candidate, plan, build, attest]
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.plan.result == 'success' && needs.plan.outputs.has_npm == 'true' &&
      (needs.build.result == 'success' || (needs.build.result == 'skipped' && needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'false')) &&
      (needs.attest.result == 'success' || (needs.attest.result == 'skipped' && needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'false'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      attestations: read
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@9234c02c00f65c7b742da4f4dd8b9fdbfbb0215a # callisto@0.22.0
        with:
          version: callisto@0.22.0
          verification: require

      # Callisto packs @orin-dx/michi with pnpm (the workspace's manager) and the platform packages with npm.
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-proto-node-pnpm@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          working-directory: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.napi_dir || 'packages/michi-node' }}
          cache: 'false'

      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
        working-directory: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.napi_dir }}

      # Downloads land under $RUNNER_TEMP: pack-npm and execute require a clean checkout.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
        with:
          pattern: napi-*
          merge-multiple: true
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-artifacts

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
        with:
          pattern: binding-*
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-bindings

      - name: Verify the handoff
        run: (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent" && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)

      # Verification pins the signing workflow and this commit's SHA, not the run ID. A binary built by another
      # workflow, or by this workflow at a different commit, fails here, before placement; a build from another run
      # of this workflow at the same commit would pass.
      - name: Verify the napi addon attestations
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          shopt -s nullglob
          addons=("$RUNNER_TEMP"/napi-artifacts/*.node)
          if [[ "${#addons[@]}" -eq 0 ]]; then
            echo "::error::no napi addons to verify"
            exit 1
          fi
          for addon in "${addons[@]}"; do
            gh attestation verify "$addon" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
              --signer-workflow "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml" \
              --signer-digest "$GITHUB_SHA" --source-digest "$GITHUB_SHA" --deny-self-hosted-runners
          done

      # Same check for the JS loader every consumer runs first, on every leg's copy.
      - name: Verify the JS binding attestations
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          shopt -s nullglob
          files=("$RUNNER_TEMP"/napi-bindings/*/index.js "$RUNNER_TEMP"/napi-bindings/*/index.d.ts)
          if [[ "${#files[@]}" -eq 0 ]]; then
            echo "::error::no JS bindings to verify"
            exit 1
          fi
          for file in "${files[@]}"; do
            gh attestation verify "$file" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
              --signer-workflow "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml" \
              --signer-digest "$GITHUB_SHA" --source-digest "$GITHUB_SHA" --deny-self-hosted-runners
          done

      # Everything placed here is gitignored, so the checkout stays clean:
      # the .node files go into the committed npm/<platform> package dirs.
      - name: Place the napi artifacts
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
        working-directory: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.napi_dir }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bindings=("$RUNNER_TEMP"/napi-bindings/*)
          for binding in "${bindings[@]}"; do
            cmp "${bindings[0]}/index.js" "$binding/index.js"
            cmp "${bindings[0]}/index.d.ts" "$binding/index.d.ts"
          done
          cp "${bindings[0]}/index.js" "${bindings[0]}/index.d.ts" .
          # napi 3.7 joins --output-dir onto the package directory, so pass it relative.
          pnpm exec napi artifacts --output-dir "$(realpath --relative-to="$PWD" "$RUNNER_TEMP/napi-artifacts")"
          for manifest in npm/*/package.json; do
            binary="$(dirname "$manifest")/$(jq -r .main "$manifest")"
            if [[ ! -f "$binary" ]]; then
              echo "::error::missing napi artifact $binary"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          if [[ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]]; then
            git status --porcelain
            echo "::error::artifact placement dirtied the release checkout"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Pack the npm packages
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/npm-dist"
          callisto release pack-npm --intent "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json" \
            --artifact-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/npm-dist"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: npm-dist
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/npm-dist/*
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  execute:
    name: Execute the planned release
    needs: [release-candidate, plan, build, attest, package-cargo, pack-npm]
    # !cancelled() rather than always(): cancelling the run must stop the one irreversible job. A skipped job blocks
    # only when it had something to do.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.plan.result == 'success' &&
      (needs.build.result == 'success' || (needs.build.result == 'skipped' && needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'false')) &&
      (needs.attest.result == 'success' || (needs.attest.result == 'skipped' && needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'false')) &&
      (needs.package-cargo.result == 'success' ||
        (needs.package-cargo.result == 'skipped' && needs.plan.outputs.has_cargo != 'true')) &&
      (needs.pack-npm.result == 'success' || (needs.pack-npm.result == 'skipped' && needs.plan.outputs.has_npm != 'true'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: callisto-release-execute
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    outputs:
      smoke_version: ${{ steps.published.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          # Callisto pushes the release tags from this checkout.
          persist-credentials: true # zizmor: ignore[artipacked]

      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@9234c02c00f65c7b742da4f4dd8b9fdbfbb0215a # callisto@0.22.0
        with:
          version: callisto@0.22.0
          verification: require

      # Node and npm from .prototools for `npm publish` and its provenance, rather than the runner image's npm. Nothing
      # is installed or built here: the tarballs were packed without credentials.
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-proto-node-pnpm@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_npm == 'true'
        with:
          cache: 'false'

      # Downloads land under $RUNNER_TEMP: `release execute` requires a clean worktree.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_npm == 'true'
        with:
          name: npm-dist
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-assets

      - name: Verify the handoff
        run: (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent" && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)

      # Records the sha256 of every packed tarball; `release execute` re-checks each one just before it publishes it,
      # and refuses an npm publish the manifest does not seal (E306).
      - name: Write the artifact manifest
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_npm == 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          callisto release artifact-manifest --intent "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json" \
            --artifact-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-assets" --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-manifest.json" --seal-npm

      # CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN and NPM_TOKEN are long-lived secrets because Callisto has no OIDC trusted publishing yet,
      # so they cannot be dropped here. Revisit when it does (the job already holds id-token: write).
      - name: Execute the release
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
          # Every npm package, @orin-dx/michi included, is now an `npm publish <tarball>`, which honours this.
          NPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE: 'true'
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ORCHESTRATION_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Callisto hands this config only to its npm publishers; the token
          # stays an ${NPM_TOKEN} reference, never written to disk.
          # shellcheck disable=SC2016
          printf '//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=${NPM_TOKEN}\n' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/callisto-npmrc"
          chmod 600 "$RUNNER_TEMP/callisto-npmrc"
          export CALLISTO_PUBLISH_NPM_CONFIG="$RUNNER_TEMP/callisto-npmrc"
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt"
          args=(--intent "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json"
            --receipt "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt/release-receipt.json" --orchestration-revision "$ORCHESTRATION_SHA")
          if [[ -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-manifest.json" ]]; then
            args+=(--artifact-manifest "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-manifest.json" --artifact-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-assets")
          fi
          callisto release execute "${args[@]}"

      # Callisto writes the receipt only after every selected operation succeeded. A registry publish that landed in
      # this run (`published`) or that a re-run adopted from a failed earlier attempt (`alreadySatisfied`) names the
      # released version here. A receipt without registry publishes, or no receipt, leaves the output empty and
      # skips the post-release smoke test.
      - name: Find the version this run released
        id: published
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version=$(scripts/released-version.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt/release-receipt.json")
          echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Summarize the receipt
        if: always()
        run: |
          receipt="$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt/release-receipt.json"
          if [[ -f "$receipt" ]]; then
            {
              echo '### Release receipt'
              echo '```json'
              cat "$receipt"
              echo '```'
            } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        if: always()
        with:
          # Per attempt: a re-run keeps each attempt's receipt instead of shadowing it.
          name: release-receipt-attempt-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-receipt
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 30

  # Installs the versions just published from the public registries into clean projects on each platform we ship
  # prebuilt binaries for, and uses them (scripts/smoke-published.sh). Needs no secrets and no write access. It
  # cannot undo a release: a failure here is the alarm that the published packages are broken.
  smoke-published:
    name: Smoke-test the published release (${{ matrix.os }})
    needs: [release-candidate, execute]
    if: needs.execute.result == 'success' && needs.execute.outputs.smoke_version != ''
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04-arm, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      RELEASED_VERSION: ${{ needs.execute.outputs.smoke_version }}
      # Every npm package of this release must carry provenance; a missing one fails the job.
      SMOKE_REQUIRE_ATTESTATIONS: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install the published packages and use them
        run: scripts/smoke-published.sh "$RELEASED_VERSION"

toolUseResult.content:
version-pr:
    name: Create or update the Callisto version PR
    needs: release-candidate
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release != 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: callisto-version-pr
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      # The default version command (`callisto version`) refreshes lockfiles
      # and the action appends --emit-decision .callisto/release-decision.json.
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/callisto-action@9234c02c00f65c7b742da4f4dd8b9fdbfbb0215a # callisto@0.22.0
        with:
          mode: version-pr
          version: callisto@0.22.0
          branch: main
          release_branch: callisto/version-packages
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

  plan:
    name: Plan the release from the merged version PR
    needs: release-candidate
    if: needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.matrix }}
      napi_dir: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.napi_dir }}
      has_napi: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.has_napi }}
      has_npm: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.has_npm }}
      has_cargo: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.has_cargo }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@9234c02c00f65c7b742da4f4dd8b9fdbfbb0215a # callisto@0.22.0
        with:
          version: callisto@0.22.0
          # Run only a Callisto binary whose attestation verifies; the default falls back to a crates.io build.
          verification: require

      - name: Plan the release
        env:
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          ORCHESTRATION_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent"
          callisto release plan --from-release-commit "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA" --decision .callisto/release-decision.json \
            --orchestration-revision "$ORCHESTRATION_SHA" --artifact-repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json"
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent" && shasum -a 256 release-intent.json > release-intent.json.sha256)

      - name: Build the matrix from the intent's napi targets
        id: matrix
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          intent="$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json"
          # This workflow builds napi addons, packages crates and packs npm packages. Artifact slots (binary release
          # assets) and PyPI publishes need the generated workflow's asset build and build-python jobs.
          if ! jq -e '(.artifactSlots // []) == [] and
            ([.operations[].id.package | select(startswith("pypi/"))] == [])' "$intent" > /dev/null; then
            echo "::error::the release intent declares artifact slots or PyPI publishes, which this workflow does not build"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Only packages in the release intent: an unrelated addon adds no build.
          {
            while IFS= read -r package; do
              callisto --format json matrix --package "$package"
            done < <(jq -r '[.operations[].id.package] | unique[]' "$intent")
          } | jq -s '{platformTargets: (map(.platformTargets) | add // {})}' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/matrix.json"
          # Callisto's hostRunner/useCross as given (aarch64 and musl Linux cross-compile with cargo-zigbuild on
          # ubuntu-latest; both macOS targets build on macos-latest).
          matrix=$(jq -c '[.platformTargets[] | select(.kind == "napi") | .targets[]] | unique_by(.artifactName)' \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/matrix.json")
          # pack-npm places one package's JS binding; a second addon needs per-package placement. A release with no
          # addon skips the build and placement entirely (the fixed group always includes the npm package today).
          napi_dirs=$(jq -c '[.[].packageDir] | unique' <<< "$matrix")
          case $(jq length <<< "$napi_dirs") in
            0) has_napi=false napi_dir="" ;;
            1) has_napi=true napi_dir=$(jq -r '.[0]' <<< "$napi_dirs") ;;
            *)
              echo "::error::expected at most one napi package directory, got $napi_dirs"
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac
          {
            echo "matrix=$matrix"
            echo "napi_dir=$napi_dir"
            echo "has_napi=$has_napi"
            echo "has_cargo=$(jq '[.operations[].id | select(.role.kind == "registryPublish" and
              (.package | startswith("cargo/")))] | length > 0' "$intent")"
            echo "has_npm=$(jq '[.operations[].id | select(.role.kind == "platformPublish" or
              (.role.kind == "registryPublish" and (.package | startswith("npm/"))))] | length > 0' "$intent")"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  # Runs project code (build scripts, the napi CLI) with no registry credential and no OIDC token: the attest job signs
  # what it uploads.
  build:
    name: Build ${{ matrix.triple }}
    needs: [release-candidate, plan]
    # An empty matrix is an error in GitHub Actions, so a release without an addon skips the job instead.
    if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include: ${{ fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.matrix) }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.hostRunner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      TRIPLE: ${{ matrix.triple }}
      USE_CROSS: ${{ matrix.useCross }}
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ${{ matrix.packageDir }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install the Rust target
        run: rustup target add "$TRIPLE"

      # Known gap: this composite runs moonrepo/setup-toolchain@v0 (floating tag, pinned only by the composite's own
      # SHA), which downloads and runs the proto and moon install scripts from moonrepo/moon's master branch
      # ("Installing `moon` globally", because .moon/ exists). Neither can be pinned from here: the script URL is
      # hardcoded in that action, and the only inputs (proto-version, moon-version) pick the release the script
      # fetches, not the script itself. Replacing the composite with a pinned setup-toolchain would still run the
      # proto script, and auto-install would add rust to the proto installs. These jobs never call moon.
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-proto-node-pnpm@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          working-directory: ${{ matrix.packageDir }}
          cache: 'false'

      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # napi's --cross-compile links non-native Linux targets with cargo-zigbuild. The linker is pinned by version and
      # wheel hash (x86_64 and aarch64 Linux runners). Bump both together from the ziglang release page on PyPI.
      - name: Install zig
        if: matrix.useCross
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          pip install --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: -r /dev/stdin <<'REQS'
          ziglang==0.17.1 \
            --hash=sha256:ea6cc5d87b033cf0aedfbc8f9549a908cae6c50ac31f1698188fa48a74524b54 \
            --hash=sha256:b7c5f02fccd40f89b999ee16a1f5ddced56e6182370f8affe494bcf8a28cf07e
          REQS

      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@cfdb7ed4ccc7c7dce37759eae89dc5674b469b39 # v2
        if: matrix.useCross
        with:
          tool: cargo-zigbuild

      # --output-dir keeps the checkout clean; napi writes the .node file and
      # the generated index.js/index.d.ts there.
      - name: Build the napi addon
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--release --target "$TRIPLE" --output-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/napi-out")
          if [[ "$USE_CROSS" == true ]]; then args+=(--cross-compile); fi
          pnpm build "${args[@]}"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: napi-${{ matrix.artifactName }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-out/*.node
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

      # index.js and index.d.ts are gitignored build outputs the npm package ships.
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: binding-${{ matrix.artifactName }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-out/index.js
            ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-out/index.d.ts
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  # Signs the bytes that get packed (each addon and the JS loader that requires it); pack-npm verifies them before it
  # places them. Holds the OIDC token, so it has no checkout and runs no command: only the attestation action sees the
  # build output. Every leg builds the same loader, so the merged download keeps one copy; pack-npm verifies each
  # leg's copy against this attestation, which also fails on a leg whose loader differs.
  attest:
    name: Attest the napi addons and JS binding
    needs: [plan, build]
    if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          pattern: napi-*
          merge-multiple: true
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-artifacts

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          pattern: binding-*
          merge-multiple: true
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-binding

      - uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-artifacts/*.node
            ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-binding/index.js
            ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-binding/index.d.ts

  # No registry credentials: compiles every crate of the release (build scripts, proc macros), so that execute
  # publishes them with --no-verify.
  package-cargo:
    name: Package the crates
    needs: [release-candidate, plan]
    if: needs.plan.outputs.has_cargo == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@9234c02c00f65c7b742da4f4dd8b9fdbfbb0215a # callisto@0.22.0
        with:
          version: callisto@0.22.0
          verification: require

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent

      - name: Verify the handoff
        run: (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent" && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)

      - name: Package the crates
        run: callisto release package-cargo --intent "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json"

  # No registry credentials: verifies and places the napi build, then packs every npm package (the six platform
  # packages and @orin-dx/michi). execute publishes these exact tarballs with `npm publish <tarball> --ignore-scripts`.
  pack-npm:
    name: Pack the npm packages
    needs: [release-candidate, plan, build, attest]
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.plan.result == 'success' && needs.plan.outputs.has_npm == 'true' &&
      (needs.build.result == 'success' || (needs.build.result == 'skipped' && needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'false')) &&
      (needs.attest.result == 'success' || (needs.attest.result == 'skipped' && needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'false'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      attestations: read
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@9234c02c00f65c7b742da4f4dd8b9fdbfbb0215a # callisto@0.22.0
        with:
          version: callisto@0.22.0
          verification: require

      # Callisto packs @orin-dx/michi with pnpm (the workspace's manager) and the platform packages with npm.
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-proto-node-pnpm@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          working-directory: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.napi_dir || 'packages/michi-node' }}
          cache: 'false'

      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
        working-directory: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.napi_dir }}

      # Downloads land under $RUNNER_TEMP: pack-npm and execute require a clean checkout.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
        with:
          pattern: napi-*
          merge-multiple: true
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-artifacts

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
        with:
          pattern: binding-*
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-bindings

      - name: Verify the handoff
        run: (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent" && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)

      # Verification pins the signing workflow and this commit's SHA, not the run ID. A binary built by another
      # workflow, or by this workflow at a different commit, fails here, before placement; a build from another run
      # of this workflow at the same commit would pass.
      - name: Verify the napi addon attestations
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          shopt -s nullglob
          addons=("$RUNNER_TEMP"/napi-artifacts/*.node)
          if [[ "${#addons[@]}" -eq 0 ]]; then
            echo "::error::no napi addons to verify"
            exit 1
          fi
          for addon in "${addons[@]}"; do
            gh attestation verify "$addon" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
              --signer-workflow "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml" \
              --signer-digest "$GITHUB_SHA" --source-digest "$GITHUB_SHA" --deny-self-hosted-runners
          done

      # Same check for the JS loader every consumer runs first, on every leg's copy.
      - name: Verify the JS binding attestations
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          shopt -s nullglob
          files=("$RUNNER_TEMP"/napi-bindings/*/index.js "$RUNNER_TEMP"/napi-bindings/*/index.d.ts)
          if [[ "${#files[@]}" -eq 0 ]]; then
            echo "::error::no JS bindings to verify"
            exit 1
          fi
          for file in "${files[@]}"; do
            gh attestation verify "$file" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
              --signer-workflow "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml" \
              --signer-digest "$GITHUB_SHA" --source-digest "$GITHUB_SHA" --deny-self-hosted-runners
          done

      # Everything placed here is gitignored, so the checkout stays clean:
      # the .node files go into the committed npm/<platform> package dirs.
      - name: Place the napi artifacts
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
        working-directory: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.napi_dir }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bindings=("$RUNNER_TEMP"/napi-bindings/*)
          for binding in "${bindings[@]}"; do
            cmp "${bindings[0]}/index.js" "$binding/index.js"
            cmp "${bindings[0]}/index.d.ts" "$binding/index.d.ts"
          done
          cp "${bindings[0]}/index.js" "${bindings[0]}/index.d.ts" .
          # napi 3.7 joins --output-dir onto the package directory, so pass it relative.
          pnpm exec napi artifacts --output-dir "$(realpath --relative-to="$PWD" "$RUNNER_TEMP/napi-artifacts")"
          for manifest in npm/*/package.json; do
            binary="$(dirname "$manifest")/$(jq -r .main "$manifest")"
            if [[ ! -f "$binary" ]]; then
              echo "::error::missing napi artifact $binary"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          if [[ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]]; then
            git status --porcelain
            echo "::error::artifact placement dirtied the release checkout"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Pack the npm packages
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/npm-dist"
          callisto release pack-npm --intent "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json" \
            --artifact-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/npm-dist"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: npm-dist
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/npm-dist/*
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  execute:
    name: Execute the planned release
    needs: [release-candidate, plan, build, attest, package-cargo, pack-npm]
    # !cancelled() rather than always(): cancelling the run must stop the one irreversible job. A skipped job blocks
    # only when it had something to do.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.plan.result == 'success' &&
      (needs.build.result == 'success' || (needs.build.result == 'skipped' && needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'false')) &&
      (needs.attest.result == 'success' || (needs.attest.result == 'skipped' && needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'false')) &&
      (needs.package-cargo.result == 'success' ||
        (needs.package-cargo.result == 'skipped' && needs.plan.outputs.has_cargo != 'true')) &&
      (needs.pack-npm.result == 'success' || (needs.pack-npm.result == 'skipped' && needs.plan.outputs.has_npm != 'true'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: callisto-release-execute
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    outputs:
      smoke_version: ${{ steps.published.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          # Callisto pushes the release tags from this checkout.
          persist-credentials: true # zizmor: ignore[artipacked]

      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@9234c02c00f65c7b742da4f4dd8b9fdbfbb0215a # callisto@0.22.0
        with:
          version: callisto@0.22.0
          verification: require

      # Node and npm from .prototools for `npm publish` and its provenance, rather than the runner image's npm. Nothing
      # is installed or built here: the tarballs were packed without credentials.
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-proto-node-pnpm@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_npm == 'true'
        with:
          cache: 'false'

      # Downloads land under $RUNNER_TEMP: `release execute` requires a clean worktree.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_npm == 'true'
        with:
          name: npm-dist
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-assets

      - name: Verify the handoff
        run: (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent" && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)

      # Records the sha256 of every packed tarball; `release execute` re-checks each one just before it publishes it,
      # and refuses an npm publish the manifest does not seal (E306).
      - name: Write the artifact manifest
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_npm == 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          callisto release artifact-manifest --intent "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json" \
            --artifact-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-assets" --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-manifest.json" --seal-npm

      # CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN and NPM_TOKEN are long-lived secrets because Callisto has no OIDC trusted publishing yet,
      # so they cannot be dropped here. Revisit when it does (the job already holds id-token: write).
      - name: Execute the release
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
          # Every npm package, @orin-dx/michi included, is now an `npm publish <tarball>`, which honours this.
          NPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE: 'true'
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ORCHESTRATION_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Callisto hands this config only to its npm publishers; the token
          # stays an ${NPM_TOKEN} reference, never written to disk.
          # shellcheck disable=SC2016
          printf '//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=${NPM_TOKEN}\n' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/callisto-npmrc"
          chmod 600 "$RUNNER_TEMP/callisto-npmrc"
          export CALLISTO_PUBLISH_NPM_CONFIG="$RUNNER_TEMP/callisto-npmrc"
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt"
          args=(--intent "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json"
            --receipt "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt/release-receipt.json" --orchestration-revision "$ORCHESTRATION_SHA")
          if [[ -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-manifest.json" ]]; then
            args+=(--artifact-manifest "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-manifest.json" --artifact-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-assets")
          fi
          callisto release execute "${args[@]}"

      # Callisto writes the receipt only after every selected operation succeeded. A registry publish that landed in
      # this run (`published`) or that a re-run adopted from a failed earlier attempt (`alreadySatisfied`) names the
      # released version here. A receipt without registry publishes, or no receipt, leaves the output empty and
      # skips the post-release smoke test.
      - name: Find the version this run released
        id: published
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version=$(scripts/released-version.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt/release-receipt.json")
          echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Summarize the receipt
        if: always()
        run: |
          receipt="$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt/release-receipt.json"
          if [[ -f "$receipt" ]]; then
            {
              echo '### Release receipt'
              echo '```json'
              cat "$receipt"
              echo '```'
            } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        if: always()
        with:
          # Per attempt: a re-run keeps each attempt's receipt instead of shadowing it.
          name: release-receipt-attempt-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-receipt
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 30

  # Installs the versions just published from the public registries into clean projects on each platform we ship
  # prebuilt binaries for, and uses them (scripts/smoke-published.sh). Needs no secrets and no write access. It
  # cannot undo a release: a failure here is the alarm that the published packages are broken.
  smoke-published:
    name: Smoke-test the published release (${{ matrix.os }})
    needs: [release-candidate, execute]
    if: needs.execute.result == 'success' && needs.execute.outputs.smoke_version != ''
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04-arm, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      RELEASED_VERSION: ${{ needs.execute.outputs.smoke_version }}
      # Every npm package of this release must carry provenance; a missing one fails the job.
      SMOKE_REQUIRE_ATTESTATIONS: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install the published packages and use them
        run: scripts/smoke-published.sh "$RELEASED_VERSION"

name: 'Setup node & pnpm via proto'
description: >-
  Installs node/pnpm from the calling repo's .prototools via proto, then
  optionally caches the pnpm store. Does not touch Rust -- pair with
  setup-rust separately in jobs that also need a specific cross-compile
  target, since a blanket proto rust install would conflict with it.
inputs:
  working-directory:
    description: 'Directory containing package.json/pnpm-lock.yaml'
    required: false
    default: '.'
  cache:
    description: 'Whether to cache the pnpm store (skip for jobs that never run pnpm install)'
    required: false
    default: 'true'
runs:
  using: 'composite'
  steps:
    - uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@261c62cb5b0f580c7be7c8cd0f023a2e96756095 # v0
    - shell: bash
      run: proto install node && proto install pnpm
    # An internal action cannot pin its own release commit without a cycle.
    - id: pnpm-cache
      if: inputs.cache == 'true'
      shell: bash
      working-directory: ${{ inputs.working-directory }}
      run: echo "STORE_PATH=$(pnpm store path --silent)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
    - uses: actions/cache@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830 # v4
      if: inputs.cache == 'true'
      with:
        path: ${{ steps.pnpm-cache.outputs.STORE_PATH }}
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-store-${{ hashFiles(format('{0}/pnpm-lock.yaml', inputs.working-directory)) }}

  setup-rust separately in jobs that also need a specific cross-compile
  target, since a blanket proto rust install would conflict with it.
inputs:
  working-directory:
    description: 'Directory containing package.json/pnpm-lock.yaml'
    required: false
    default: '.'
  cache:
    description: 'Whether to cache the pnpm store (skip for jobs that never run pnpm install)'
    required: false
    default: 'true'
runs:
  using: 'composite'
  steps:
    - uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@261c62cb5b0f580c7be7c8cd0f023a2e96756095 # v0
    - shell: bash
      run: proto install node && proto install pnpm
    # An internal action cannot pin its own release commit without a cycle.
    - id: pnpm-cache
      if: inputs.cache == 'true'
      shell: bash
      working-directory: ${{ inputs.working-directory }}
      run: echo "STORE_PATH=$(pnpm store path --silent)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
    - uses: actions/cache@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830 # v4
      if: inputs.cache == 'true'
      with:
        path: ${{ steps.pnpm-cache.outputs.STORE_PATH }}
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-store-${{ hashFiles(format('{0}/pnpm-lock.yaml', inputs.working-directory)) }}

input.content:
chore(release): upgrade Callisto to 0.22.0

Callisto 0.22 publishes npm packages only from tarballs sealed in an
artifact manifest (E306 otherwise) and publishes crates with --no-verify,
expecting a credential-free job to have packaged them first. The release
workflow gains the jobs that contract needs:

- attest: signs the napi addons and JS binding with no checkout, so the
  build legs no longer hold an OIDC token
- package-cargo: `callisto release package-cargo`, no credentials
- pack-npm: verifies the attestations, places the build output and runs
  `callisto release pack-npm`, no credentials
- execute: seals the tarballs with `artifact-manifest --seal-npm` and
  passes the manifest to `release execute`

The provenance gate, workflow_dispatch recovery, per-SHA concurrency,
zigbuild cross-compile, receipt handling and smoke test are unchanged.
The x86_64-apple-darwin runner override is gone: 0.22 schedules that
target on macos-latest itself. PNPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE is gone: every
npm publish is now `npm publish <tarball>`, which honours
NPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE.

callisto.toml drops every key that restates a 0.22 default; the release
plan, tags and fixed group are unchanged (checked with the 0.22 binary).
CI's callisto-validate moves to 0.22.0 too.
